findings.issue: The --depth-mode row gives the caps as 'maxDepth 3, maxChildrenPerNode 6' with no root exception. A review root takes up to 8 depth-1 children: frontier-admit.cjs:61 sets ROOT_CHILDREN_FLOOR review: 8, readCaps (frontier-admit.cjs:317) sets maxRootChildren = max(maxChildrenPerNode, 8), and deep-review.yaml:329 and :910 ask the seed step for 3 to 8 sub-targets. Run 16 accepted this as C4-5 for deep-review/README.md, and commit 555be348b61 fixed the README (line 166 now says 'A review root takes up to 8 depth-1 children'), but this operator-facing flag row, unchanged since then, still states 6. research.md:107 is fine because the research root floor is also 6.

The PRE-BOUND SETUP ANSWERS example indents lineage_mode, extend and extend_minutes by one space while every other field uses two. The extend and extend_minutes lines are new in this diff and copy the one-space indent of the existing lineage_mode line. auto-mode-contract.md section 2 says 'Each field is `  <key>: <value>` indented two spaces, one per line', and the block is described as YAML-style, so a caller copying this template writes a block that breaks the grammar. deep-research-presentation.txt indents all its fields by two spaces.

findings.issue: The rewritten command_note says the check 'prints one machine reason (dispatch_failed|...|delta_file_missing|executor_missing)' and then exempts 'executor_missing, findings_not_enumerated and ledger_backing_missing' from redispatch. Two of the three exempted reasons are not in its own list. verify-iteration.cjs REASONS also returns state_log_malformed, delta_file_malformed and gateway_bypass_detected, none listed. The exemption itself is correct; the reason list it hangs off is stale, so an operator reading a findings_not_enumerated exit finds it undocumented here.

Same as D-3 on the review side: the rewritten command_note lists eight reasons (with iteration_verdict_missing) and then exempts findings_not_enumerated and ledger_backing_missing, which its list omits. findings_not_enumerated is mostly a review reason (verify-iteration.cjs:534-546 branches on loopType === 'review'), so the omission matters most here.
